events.description: Called with the new `RRULE` text on every change.
events.name: onChange

props.description: The rule, for example `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SU,WE`, for a controlled editor; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The rule at the start, for an uncontrolled editor. Defaults to every week on the start day's weekday.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The first day (the event's `DTSTART`): it picks the default weekday, day of month and month. Defaults to today.
props.name: startDate

props.description:
The calendar months count in: `islamic-umalqura` makes "every month on the 1st" the Hijri 1st (RFC 7529 `RSCALE`)
and writes month names and the end date in Hijri. Defaults to `gregory`; a rule that names its own wins.
props.name: calendar

props.description: The group's name, for example "Repeat"; defaults to the catalogue's.
props.name: label

props.description: True to show the rule but refuse changes.
props.name: isDisabled
